answer: A concrete defense against Sybils is a per-identity proof-of-work ticket an agent must solve from a random per-epoch challenge before any job is assigned, backed by a small spendable escrow locked for that epoch. To field N clones, the attacker must find N valid tickets and fund N escrows, so cost scales linearly with puppets rather than a flat fee. A lone sparrow pays once for itself; a farm pays per fake twin, and idle farms bleed bankroll each epoch on challenge and stake, while a zephyr of tiny spares cannot outrun the locked umber of collateral.
